name: Logseq
description: Brings a Logseq graph in and takes notes back out: pages become notes (namespaces as folders), journals daily notes, blocks nested lists with their properties, block refs links to the block, TODO/DOING/DONE tasks in the Tasks plugin's format with their dates, simple queries Tasks or Dataview queries, and assets attachments. Importing again adds only what's new; exporting writes a graph Logseq opens.
author: Vaultite
forAgents: Moving a Logseq graph in: `logseq_import` (its folder or zip; `logseq_job` follows it). Back out: `logseq_export` (a folder, to a folder or .zip). How each thing maps: `vau docs logseq`.

folder.label: Folder
folder.description: where a graph's pages go (its journals go where daily notes do, its assets in the attachments folder)
